cues: Count them all for C four H ten O.
Four alcohols, and three ethers, seven isomers in all.
Any alcohol and any ether are functional isomers.
And within the ethers, one methoxypropane and two methoxypropane differ only in the chain, so they are chain or position isomers, not metamers.
